title: Project Engineer / Project Coordinator – Civil
description:
**Title:** Project Engineer / Project Coordinator – Civil  
**Department:** Planning, Technical Coordination \& Estimation  
**Location:** Head Office, Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Education:** B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering

We are looking for a **Project Engineer / Project Coordinator – Civil** to join our technical coordination team. The role involves coordinating between architects, structural and MEP consultants, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to ensure smooth project execution.

The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of **civil construction drawings, AutoCAD, BOQ, estimation, vendor quotations, and project coordination**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP teams, site engineers, contractors, and clients.
* Review architectural and structural drawings for dimensions, constructability, and coordination issues.
* Maintain drawing registers, revisions, approvals, and document records.
* Ensure site teams are working with the latest approved **GFC (Good for Construction) drawings**.
* Coordinate with site teams to resolve drawing\-related issues and RFIs.
* Handle client modification and customization requests.
* Coordinate with consultants to assess the technical and cost impact of variations.
* Prepare and review **BOQ, rate analysis, debit/credit notes, and variation calculations**.
* Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors for quotations and technical requirements.
* Compare vendor quotations and prepare **Comparative Statements (CS)**.
* Support procurement and senior management in vendor evaluation and negotiations.
* Maintain project reports and documentation.

**Requirements**

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* **3–7 years of relevant experience** in construction/project coordination/technical office/drawing coordination.
* Good working knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel** for calculations, comparison, reporting, and rate analysis.
* Good understanding of **civil/structural drawings, BOQ, estimation, and construction processes**.
* Experience in residential or commercial construction projects is preferred.
* Knowledge of **MS Project or Primavera** is an added advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving ability.

**Key Skills**

**Civil Engineering \| AutoCAD \| Drawing Coordination \| GFC Drawings \| BOQ \| Estimation \| Rate Analysis \| MS Excel \| Variation Management \| Vendor Coordination \| Comparative** 

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organised and proactive **Project Coordinator** to manage the smooth execution of Web Development, Software and Digital Marketing projects. Once a project is confirmed by the Business Development team, you will coordinate with the client and our internal teams from **project handover and planning through final delivery**.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys communication, planning, teamwork and keeping projects organised and on track.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Web \& Software Projects**

* Receive project handover from the Business Development team and clearly understand the committed scope, timeline and deliverables.
* Conduct the initial project discussion/kick\-off with the client and finalise the project scope.
* Prepare the project plan, milestones and delivery timeline.
* Assign and coordinate tasks with Designers, Developers and other required team members.
* Coordinate with the Testing/QA team and track corrections before client review.
* Conduct the first internal/project review and ensure the work is ready for client presentation.
* Coordinate **MVP/initial delivery** with the client and collect structured feedback.
* Communicate client corrections clearly to the respective internal teams and track their completion.
* Identify requests that fall outside the agreed scope and coordinate with the client and Business Development team before proceeding.
* Manage final corrections, approvals and successful project delivery.

**Digital Marketing Projects**

* Receive the project handover after client confirmation and understand the committed services and expectations.
* Assign the appropriate Digital Marketing, Design, Content and Development team members.
* Coordinate monthly/weekly content and campaign calendar planning.
* Ensure required designs, content, landing pages, website updates and campaign\-related development activities are completed on time.
* Coordinate regularly between the **client, Digital Marketing team, Designers, Developers and Business Development team**.
* Track campaign activities, pending client inputs, approvals and deliverables.
* Organise weekly or monthly client review meetings based on the project requirement.
* Share progress updates, collect feedback and coordinate the next action plan with the team.

**General Project Coordination**

* Maintain clear project timelines, task trackers and follow\-ups.
* Keep clients informed about project progress and upcoming deliverables.
* Coordinate internal teams to avoid delays and communication gaps.
* Review deliverables before they are shared with clients.
* Document important discussions, approvals, scope changes and action items.
* Handle multiple projects in an organised and professional manner.
* Escalate timeline, scope or delivery concerns to the appropriate team at the right time.

**Skills We Are Looking For**

* Master/Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in Project Coordination, Account Management or a similar role.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organization, follow\-up and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to communicate confidently with clients and internal teams.
* Basic understanding of **Website Development, UI/UX and Digital Marketing workflows**.
* Ability to understand client requirements and convert them into clear tasks for the team.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Familiarity with project/task management and office productivity tools is an advantage.

What This Role Is About

* You will act as the **connecting point between the client, Business Development team and delivery teams**, helping everyone stay aligned from project confirmation through successful delivery.

Location: Coimbatore

.

title: Project Coordinator
company: High Think Media Box Private Limited
description:
**Job Title: Project Co\-Ordinator**  
**Company : Antsquad Branding Studio**  
**Job Location: Anna Silai, Coimbatore**

**About the Role** HighThink Media Box is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ownership\-driven Project Coordinator to lead and manage branding and creative projects from initiation to final delivery. This role is critical to our agency’s success, acting as the central bridge between clients, creative teams, and leadership. The Project Coordinator will ensure that every project is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with brand strategy and quality standards.

This is a high\-responsibility role and a key pillar in scaling HighThink Media Box operations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced creative environment, understands branding workflows, and can manage multiple projects while maintaining clarity, structure, and accountability across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning \& Execution**

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of branding and creative projects.
* Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and milestones.
* Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign them to relevant teams.
* Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**Client Coordination \& Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Understand client requirements, objectives, and brand expectations clearly.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and status communication.
* Handle client feedback professionally and translate it into actionable tasks.
* Build strong, long\-term client relationships through clear communication and reliability.

**Team Collaboration \& Workflow Management**

* Coordinate with Brand Designers, Video Editors, Content Writers, and Digital Marketers.
* Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and avoid bottlenecks.
* Conduct daily/weekly follow\-ups to track progress and maintain accountability.
* Ensure all team members are aligned with project goals and deadlines.

**Timeline \& Delivery Management**

* Create and maintain project timelines, trackers, and dashboards.
* Monitor progress and proactively address delays or risks.
* Ensure timely delivery without compromising quality.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with structured prioritization.

**Quality Control \& Brand Alignment**

* Ensure all deliverables meet agency quality standards and brand guidelines.
* Review outputs before client submission to maintain consistency and excellence.
* Work closely with creative teams to ensure brand strategy is reflected in execution.

**Meeting \& Documentation**

* Schedule and lead internal and client meetings.
* Document meeting notes, action items, and responsibilities.
* Ensure follow\-ups are completed within deadlines.
* Maintain structured project documentation, reports, and archives.

**Risk Management \& Problem Solving**

* Identify potential risks, delays, or resource gaps early.
* Take proactive steps to resolve issues and keep projects on track.
* Handle unexpected challenges calmly and provide solutions quickly.

**Process Improvement \& Productivity**

* Identify gaps in workflows and suggest improvements.
* Implement tools and systems to improve team efficiency and project tracking.
* Contribute to building standard operating procedures (SOPs) for project management.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in Project Management, Client Servicing, or Operations/Coordination roles.
* Experience in a branding, advertising, digital marketing, or creative agency is highly preferred.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making mindset.
* High level of ownership and accountability.

**Technical \& Tool Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Basic understanding of branding processes, creative workflows, and digital marketing deliverables.

**Preferred Traits**

* Understands branding, creativity, and client expectations.
* Can bring structure to a fast\-moving creative environment.
* Is highly proactive and solution\-oriented.
* Takes complete ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Has strong follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Can confidently interact with both clients and internal teams.
* Is adaptable and thrives under pressure.
* Focuses on driving execution leadership that directly impacts client satisfaction, delivery timelines, team productivity, and agency growth.

title: Project Change & Configuration Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Could you be the full\-time Project Configuration and Change Management (PCCM) Leader in Coimbatore we’re looking for?


**Your future role**

  



Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in configuration and change management to a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, driven, and innovative teammates.



You'll ensure accuracy, consistency, and traceability of delivered products and services to internal and external customers, keeping configurations under control and managing changes throughout the lifecycle of key projects, programs, or products. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including procurement, industrial, tender/project management, and quality), lead Configuration and Change Management (CCM) activities, and much more.



You’ll specifically take care of defining the Configuration Management Plan (CMP) and leading Change Control Boards, but also monitoring CCM performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives.



We’ll look to you for:



Leading CCM activities and deliverables for projects, programs, or products



Defining and issuing Configuration Baseline Release Notes



Ensuring consistency and integrity of baselines across projects



Performing Configuration Audits and issuing Configuration Status Accounting Reports



Coordinating and managing Change Requests end\-to\-end



Monitoring CCM performance and implementing corrective actions



Identifying and mitigating CCM\-related risks



Providing feedback and contributing to the continuous improvement of CCM processes and tools

  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:



Degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Management, or a related field



Experience in configuration and change management, with at least 8 years in a similar role



Knowledge of railway products, solutions, and systems



Familiarity with CCM tools (e.g., ALM, EWM, PLM)



A CMII certification or equivalent is a plus



Strong skills in communication, negotiation, and cross\-functional team management



Proficiency in Microsoft Office and fluency in English



Systematic, proactive, and detail\-oriented approach



Leadership skills and the ability to influence and guide stakeholders

  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:



Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines



Work with new security standards for rail signalling



Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues



Contribute to innovative projects



Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment



Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries



Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning



Progress towards leadership or specialist roles in CCM



Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  



You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  


**Important to note**



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Project Manager, Change Management, Business Manager, PLM, Procurement, Technology, Management, Operations

title: Salesforce Functional Project Manager
description:
**10 \-12 Years of Experience**
-------------------------------


### **Location: Coimbatore, Chennai, USA \- Remote**

  

  

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The Salesforce Functional Project Manager will be responsible for leading Salesforce implementation and enhancement projects from a functional and delivery perspective. This role acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are clearly defined, translated into functional solutions, and delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality. The role requires strong Salesforce functional expertise, stakeholder management, and project governance skills.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
----------------------------------


### **Project \& Delivery Management**


* Lead end\-to\-end Salesforce projects including implementations, enhancements, migrations, and integrations.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables in alignment with business goals.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Salesforce Admins, Developers, QA, and external vendors.

### **Business \& Functional Leadership**


* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Validate proposed Salesforce solutions to ensure alignment with business needs and Salesforce best practices.
* Lead functional design workshops, requirement walkthroughs, and solution review sessions.

### **Salesforce Functional Oversight**


* Provide functional leadership across Salesforce clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud (as applicable).
* Ensure proper configuration of Salesforce features including workflows, flows, validation rules, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Oversee data management, data migration, and data quality activities.
* Ensure system usability, scalability, and adoption across user groups.
  

  

### **Stakeholder \& Communication Management**


* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Provide regular project updates, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve functional or delivery\-related conflicts.

### **Quality Assurance \& Governance**


* Ensure adherence to project governance, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Review functional designs and test cases to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Support UAT planning, execution, defect triage, and sign\-off.
* Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, data privacy, and access control standards.

### **Change Management \& Adoption**


* Support change management activities including user training, documentation, and rollout planning.
* Ensure smooth transition from project delivery to post\-go\-live support.
* Drive user adoption through effective communication and training initiatives.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
--------------------------------------


### **Salesforce Functional Skills**


* Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce platform and core features.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce configuration (Flows, Reports, Dashboards, Security Model).
* Experience working across Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Experience; Marketing Cloud is a plus).
* Understanding of Salesforce data model, integrations, and APIs (functional perspective).

### **Project Management Skills**


* Proven experience managing Salesforce or CRM projects.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Experience in risk management, scope control, and resource planning.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

### **Stakeholder \& Communication Skills**


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership abilities.
* Ability to present project status and functional solutions to senior management.

### **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills**


* Strong analytical skills to translate complex business needs into scalable solutions.
* Proactive problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------


* Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Business Analyst.
* Experience working with system integrators or consulting environments.
* Experience in data migration, system integrations, and enterprise CRM programs.

**Experience Required:**
------------------------


* **10\+ years** of overall experience with **5\+ years** in Salesforce functional or project management roles.
